report:
Thyroid, total thyroidectomy

Received in formalin is a total thyroidectomy specimen weighing 28 g and measuring right lobe 5 x 3 x 2 cm, left lobe 4.5 x 2.5 x 2 cm, isthmus 2 x 1.5 x 0.8 cm. The thyroid capsule is intact. Sectioning shows a firm, pale white infiltrative mass in the left lobe measuring 26 x 20 x 18 mm. The background parenchyma is unremarkable. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-5) Right lobe tumour with capsule and posterior margin.
(6) Isthmus.
(7-8) Left lobe.
(9-10) Central compartment lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total thyroidectomy
- Tumour site: Left lobe
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour size: 26 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 26 x 20 x 18 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Medullary thyroid carcinoma
- Medullary thyroid carcinoma grade (IMTCGS): High grade
- Mitotic count (per 2 mm2): Greater than or equal to 5 mitoses per 2 mm2 (6 per
  2 mm2)
- Ki-67 labelling index: 8.5%
- Tumour necrosis: Present
- Angioinvasion: Focal (< 4 vessels)
- Lymphatic invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Extrathyroidal extension: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the thyroid show medullary thyroid carcinoma in the left lobe. Nests, sheets and trabeculae of polygonal to spindle-shaped parafollicular cells with finely granular salt-and-pepper chromatin lie in a fibrous stroma with amyloid deposition.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by carcinoma (posterior surface, 2 mm)

Lymph nodes
- Central compartment (level VI / VII): 2 of 5 involved (level VI)
- Lateral neck / retropharyngeal (levels I-V): 3 of 14 involved (left levels
  II-IV)
- Extranodal extension (ENE): Present
- Size of largest metastatic deposit: 12 mm (left level III)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pN1b

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: C-cell hyperplasia (neoplastic, bilateral)

Molecular studies
- Other molecular studies: RET p.Met918Thr mutation detected

THYROID, total thyroidectomy:
- MEDULLARY THYROID CARCINOMA, high grade, 26 mm
- Margins clear
- 2 of 5 central compartment and 3 of 14 lateral neck lymph nodes involved;
  extranodal extension present
- pT2 pN1b (AJCC 8th edition).
